dict.string: Personal OS uses the camera for video consultations with a practitioner you have chosen.

Personal OS reads steps, distance, flights, and walking metrics to sync with your hub. If you use the cycle page, it also reads your period from Health; that stays on this phone and is never sent anywhere.
Personal OS writes one thing to Health: a period you record on the cycle page. It is saved to Health so your watch can use it and so you can delete it there yourself.
So you can talk to the assistant and join video calls with a nutritionist.
So you can talk to the assistant instead of typing.
